newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Fipe inflation at 0.78 pct - Fipe.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Fipe inflation at 0.78 pct - Fipe.

text.p: Brazil's inflation was 0.78 percent in the Oct 8-Nov 7 period as measured by the Economic Research Institute (Fipe), up from 0.58 percent in the previous four week period, Fipe president Juarez Rizzieri said.
He said higher clothing and food prices helped accelerate the price index, which measures costs in the city of Sao Paulo.
Clothing prices jumped 2.27 percent and food prices rose 0.79 percent in the period.
Rizzieri said he expected the November Fipe index to end around one percent. He gave the following breakdown of the Fipe weighted index for the period.
- Food 0.79 pct rise in the period
The Fipe index is calculated by the University of Sao Paulo, which releases inflation figures at weekly intervals.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
